CUSTOM — REVIEW REQUIRED: U1300A–E
Construction authorized; SEL HIGH closes S <-> D, LOW opens.

PA0/PA1/PA4/PA5: analog mode, no pulls. Start10Hz scan.
160.5-cycle sampling, fADC <=35MHz; calibrate after power-up.
Honor ADC regulator/reference startup; rearm after >100us idle.
Discard first conversion after channel changes; wait >=2ms
following switch qualification or large rail transition.

OPEN: actual settling/crosstalk, reference/VREFINT accuracy,
all-path injection/leakage and rapid/slow brownout/PVT.
Ioff +/-2uA atVDD=0 is not a floating/brownout bound.
TPS assertion20us /hysteresis29mV are TYP only.
Dedicated qualifier; no shared SWD control or MCU permission.

DEVELOPMENT: SYS/BATT <=60V, protected5V <=6V, essential3V3 <=3.6V are imposed ceilings, NOT arbitrary-fault survival.
S11 fields saved; exact field-anchor/font/visibility API limitations remain. Stock mapped lands reused; TMUX7.70x5.90mm/TPS3.86x4.04mm reservation.
No ADC value authorizes power. RBF,3V3 OV, charger-to-pack fault, coupled startup / hot SOA and commissioning remain OPEN.
